current_state.meaning: The public repository/worktree now contains a first reviewed, append-only set of RedCap Forge public knowledge entries. This proves the promotion pipeline can work, but it is not a mature or complete public knowledge base.

template_only_allowed_claims: RedCap Forge defines the future promotion path
public entries require privacy review, dedupe and append-only creation before promotion
template_only_forbidden_claims: historical RedCap reports, lessons or identity have been publicly migrated
redcap-arsenal is already a populated shared knowledge base
redcap-arsenal is already a populated skill arsenal
template-only repository proves RedCap is public-release-ready
raw private reports or runtime evidence may be published directly
reviewed_substantive_allowed_claims: redcap-arsenal has a first reviewed-substantive entry set
the first entries live under users/Norven/
entries were produced through RedCap Forge-style privacy, dedupe, structure, index, and append-only checks
indexes/catalog.json provides metadata-first discovery for the current public entries

all historical RedCap reports or lessons have been publicly migrated
redcap-arsenal is already a mature public skill arsenal
reviewed-substantive entries prove RedCap is public-release-ready

release_relation.reason: An empty public arsenal must be described honestly, but it does not by itself block engineering work on the CLI/runtime package.

must_not_claim: Do not claim redcap-arsenal is mature or complete just because substantive_entries is greater than 0.
Do not claim historical private assets have been publicly migrated.
Do not claim public arsenal content strategy completion equals npm release readiness.
Do not publish private raw reports, identity, lessons or runtime evidence directly into redcap-arsenal.
